parts.name: Countertop
parts.Basic_description: The countertop is the top surface of the cabinet, made of laminate wood, providing a smooth and durable surface.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main surface for placing items such as cosmetics, accessories, or decorative objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-movable part attached to the top of the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Mirror
parts.Basic_description: The mirror is a flat reflective glass panel mounted on the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to view their reflection, typically used for grooming or dressing purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed component, securely attached to the cabinet frame without moving parts.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the structural body of the furniture, made of plywood for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the countertop and mirror, and provides internal storage compartments for organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is a rigid, non-movable structure that holds all other parts together.
